display.purpose: Live desk height only — SF Pro Rounded 36pt bold. The one expressive type moment in the app.

headline.purpose: Section titles, preset slot numbers, popover headers.

motion.name: preset-pulse
motion.purpose: Opacity oscillation on a preset cell while the desk is moving toward it. The interface's only recurring animation.

components.name: Preset Cell (inactive)
components.description: One of four hardware preset slots — control-gray rounded rect, accent slot number, secondary height caption.
components.css: .ds-preset-cell { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 96px; padding: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0.5px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-preset-num { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #007AFF; } .ds-preset-h { font-size: 10px; color: #6E6E73; }

components.name: Preset Cell (active)
components.description: The slot the desk currently sits at — accent tint (15%) plus a 2pt accent ring.
components.css: .ds-preset-cell { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 96px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-preset-cell--active { background: rgba(0,122,255,0.15); border: 2px solid #007AFF; } .ds-preset-num { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #007AFF; } .ds-preset-h { font-size: 10px; color: #6E6E73; }

components.name: Preset Cell (empty / + Add)
components.description: An unconfigured slot as invitation — 65% opacity (one shade above the 40% disconnected dim) and an accent '+ Add' caption; double-click saves the current height.
components.css: .ds-preset-cell { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 96px; padding: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0.5px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-preset-cell--empty { opacity: 0.65; } .ds-preset-num { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #007AFF; } .ds-preset-add { font-size: 10px; color: #007AFF; }

components.name: Warning Banner
components.description: Stand-down notice shown at the top of the popover when the desk reports a fault — orange tint, triangle icon, secondary message.
components.html: Desk needs initialisation — hold DOWN on the control box.
components.css: .ds-warn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; background: rgba(255,149,0,0.12); border-radius: 8px; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-warn-text { font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.35; color: #6E6E73; }

components.name: Bordered Button
components.description: Standard macOS bordered button — the movement controls (min 64pt), Apply, and most actions.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-width: 64px; padding: 4px 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #007AFF; font: 400 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0.5px 1.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); cursor: default; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #F5F5F7; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,122,255,0.3); } .ds-btn:active { background: #ECECEE; }

components.name: Prominent Button
components.description: borderedProminent — the primary action of a surface (Connect, Retry). Accent-filled, white label.
components.css: .ds-btn-prom { min-width: 64px; padding: 4px 12px; background: #007AFF; color: #FFFFFF; font: 400 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0.5px 1.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); cursor: default; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-prom:hover { background: #0066D6; } .ds-btn-prom:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,122,255,0.3); } .ds-btn-prom:active { background: #005BBB; }

components.name: Plain Accent Button
components.description: borderless text button in accent — Back, Disconnect, the settings gear. Hoverable but chrome-free.
components.css: .ds-btn-plain { padding: 2px 4px; background: transparent; color: #007AFF; font: 400 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; border: none; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-plain:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-btn-plain:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0,122,255,0.5); outline-offset: 1px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: macOS segmented picker — unit (cm/inch) and movement mode (hold/auto) choices.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; background: #E4E4E6; border-radius: 7px; padding: 2px; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-item { padding: 3px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; font-size: 12px; color: #3C3C43; cursor: default; } .ds-seg-item--on { background: #007AFF; color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0,122,255,0.5); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Height Readout
components.description: The live height — 36pt bold SF Pro Rounded, the largest element in the app.
components.css: .ds-readout { font-family: -apple-system, "SF Pro Rounded", ui-rounded, sans-serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0em; color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-readout-unit { font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Menu Bar Readout
components.description: Zone-2 status text in the menu bar — active preset + live height, or a state string.

components.name: Progress Bars
components.description: First-run flow progress — a row of thin bars, filled segments in accent, remainder in secondary at 30%.
components.css: .ds-bars { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-bar { flex: 1; height: 4px; border-radius: 1px; background: rgba(60,60,67,0.3); } .ds-bar--on { background: #007AFF; }

narrative.overview:
Lever's interface is honest machinery. It looks and behaves like something macOS shipped, because everything about it is borrowed from the platform: system accent, system materials, system text styles, SF Symbols, standard controls. There is no brand color, no custom typeface, no decorative chrome. The ambition is not to be noticed — it is to be trusted on sight, the way a physical instrument panel earns trust by reporting exactly what the machine is doing and nothing more.

That restraint is a product decision, not an absence of design. The desk is a piece of hardware that physically moves; the interface is its readout and its controls. Every pixel exists to answer "what is the desk doing right now" or to move it. Color appears when the machine has something to say (a fault, an active preset, a confirmation) — which is why a quiet gray interface can shout effectively when it needs to.
keyCharacteristics: Pure system accent — inherits the user's macOS theme, zero brand color
Semantic color only: accent = active/actionable, orange = fault, green = confirmed, red = destructive
One expressive type moment: the 36 pt rounded weight readout
8 pt rounded rectangles as the sole geometry beyond system chrome
Content surface is flat; depth lives in the system popover material

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Rule
rules.body: If a color does not come from a semantic system token (accent, orange, green, red, secondary, controlBackground), it does not belong in this interface. Brand color is a deliberate absence.

rules.name: The Rounded Readout Rule
rules.body: .rounded is reserved for the live height number — one expressive moment that makes the instrument feel machined. Everything else uses default SF Pro.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No element inside the popover draws a custom shadow. State changes are expressed by tint, border, and opacity — never by lift.

rules.name: The One-Radius Rule
rules.body: If a new container is needed, it takes 8 pt. If the system provides a shape (buttons, segmented control, popover), the system's shape wins unmodified.

dos: Do use `Color.accentColor` for anything interactive — it is the only accent this app will ever have.
Do express state through tint (15 % accent fill), border (2 pt accent ring), and opacity (40 % dim) — the established state vocabulary.
Do keep the 280 pt column; new surfaces fit inside it.
Do use `.secondary` for every hint, caption, and explanation.
Do let system controls keep their shape, material, and behavior.
donts: Don't introduce a brand color, custom font, gradient, or custom shadow — the absence of all four is the identity.
Don't use `.rounded` type anywhere except the height readout.
Don't use orange, green, or red decoratively — each already means fault, confirmed, and destructive.
Don't add container radii other than 8 pt (or 1 pt for bars).
Don't hide or jump the layout on disconnect — dim to 40 % instead.
